name: Margot, the Innkeeper
summary: Keeper of the Night-Owl. Brisk, warm, sharp-eyed. One drink buys half the town's rumors — but she sizes you up in return: 'That pallor, girl — is it days of sleepless road, or were you just born that white?'

knows: Who in town died lately; what happened in the dark alley
Where the inquisitor lodges and why he came
What rare thing the noble is buying
does_not_know: That Eliane is ageless — but her instinct is keen; pressed for details, she grows suspicious

reactions.buy_her_drink: Opens up, lets slip a key rumor (trust+)
reactions.stay_the_night: Gives you a room that locks (lowers the risk of being seen sleeping rough)
reactions.probing_questions: If you stammer or contradict yourself → she doesn't say so, but she remembers (quiet suspicion rise)
